# Inclusion and categories

The directory records public X accounts connected to AI, LLMs, agents, software development, or technology. Its function is collection and categorization. It does not write recommendations, score accounts, or impose a minimum follower count.

- One record per numeric X account ID. Update a renamed handle instead of duplicating it.
- Assign one main category from the category list. The category organizes the account, not its importance.
- Copy the X bio verbatim. Keep its original language and wording, even if it is brief or promotional.
- Record the exact follower count and actual observation time. Unknown values stay null.
- Do not add editorial descriptions, personal judgments, account-type labels, content-language labels, or evidence links to rows.
- Use the [PR workflow](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for additions and changes. Removal requests do not require private identity documents.

Public profile fields may change after collection. Snapshot metadata remains in JSON/CSV for future updates. Bios and trademarks retain their owners' rights.
